responsibility: Implements the utility that generates a C or C++ startup/termination source file from an ordered list of gm2 modules. It reads module names, emits external prototypes for each module’s `_M2_<module>_init` and `_M2_<module>_finish` routines, synthesizes initializer and finalizer functions (or constructor/destructor functions for shared libraries), optionally calls runtime initial/termination procedures, and writes a `main` function wrapper when needed, thereby producing the glue code that drives module initialization order at link/run time.
